$comment: The source of sf-wizard-step's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js), in the 1.4 form (scripts/generate-component-files.mjs writes the generated files from it). One step of sf-wizard (owner decision 2026-11-06, ui-control control/decisions/2026-11-06-sf-wizard.md): what the step is and where it stands, and its body as its children.

name.summary: The step's key: what current names, what events carry, the key of its answers in the wizard's value. Its place (step-1, step-2 …) when empty.

label.summary: The step's short name in the progress («Адрес панели»).

heading.summary: The step's title over its body; the label when empty.

description.summary: Why the step is there, one or two sentences under the title.

type.summary: What the step does, and so its primary button: info shows (Далее); form takes fields and validates them (Далее saves the step); action runs a long action (Запустить, then Далее; Повторить after an error); review shows what will be done with a way back to each step (Применить); result says what happened (Готово).

optional.summary: The step may be skipped: the wizard draws «Пропустить», and a skipped step reads skipped.

href.summary: Place pages: the step's own address. Back and a press on the step in the progress go there.

action-text.summary: The primary button's label on this step («Выпустить сертификат», «Импортировать»); the type's word when empty. Retry and the move on after an action keep their own words.

message.summary: What the step's action came to, one sentence: drawn as sf-alert in the step, success while the step is done, error while it is error. While running, the line beside the indicator.

state.summary: Where the step stands: empty (not started), done, skipped, running (its action is under way) or error. The host writes it; in places inline and modal the wizard also writes done and skipped when a person moves on.

body.$comment: The children are the step's body -- a form of Framework fields, a picture, a status, a plan of changes -- and stay where the page put them: never copied.

default.$comment: Draws nothing: the body is the children, and sf-wizard draws the rest.

accessibility.$comment: The step draws no box and takes no role: its children are read in the wizard's body, under the title the wizard draws.

x-summary: One step of sf-wizard: its key, label, title, «why», type, optional, address in place pages, primary label and result line as attributes, its state as a value, and its body -- a form, a picture, a plan of changes -- as its children, which stay where the page put them.

x-source.brief: Owner decision 2026-11-06 (ui-control control/decisions/2026-11-06-sf-wizard.md): sf-wizard is the frame and each step a child sf-wizard-step with its title, «why» text and any content.

x-decisions: name: sf-wizard-step, a part of block wizard (sf-<block>-<variant>, ui-control control/decisions/2026-11-02-smart-component-naming.md), as sf-tree-item is of sf-tree.

it draws nothing: its children are the body and stay live nodes; sf-wizard places the step in its body and draws its title, its «why», its indicator, its result and the footer from these attributes. Alone, outside a wizard, it shows its children.
types (owner): info, form, action, review, result; each gives the primary button its word, action-text replaces it.

state is a value the host writes (done, skipped, running, error, or empty for not started); message is the result's sentence. A change is told to the wizard that holds the step, which draws it at once.

css-variables: none of its own -- it draws nothing and has no sheet; the title, the indicator, the result and the footer around its children are sf-wizard's, and sf-wizard's public variables reach them (standard 1.3.15 §6; simai/ui-source#46 item 5).

version 1.0.1 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint snapshots follow the actions block (docs review R031, R032; decisions C13-C15): the sf-button and sf-button-icon it draws ask for the screen-reader-only utility sheet (sf-button 1.9.0, sf-button-icon 1.7.0), an sf-button-close it draws asks for its own sheet (C14), and sf-input's classes follow its outer sizes (sf-input 1.6.0). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.
version 1.0.2 (2026-11-09): a patch, nothing drawn differently. The manifest says why it declares no css-variables (simai/ui-source#46 item 5), as sf-language and sf-settings do.

version 1.0.3 (2026-11-09): a patch; nothing in the component changed. The sf-input it draws asks for the kbd sheet since sf-input 1.7.0 (C38, the shortcut setting; component.kbd 1.3.0), so its first-paint snapshots name that sheet and carry one more empty line where the field's shortcut would stand; the component takes a patch with them. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: running the step's action (the host or the server does)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-wizard-step only inside sf-wizard, one per step.
do_not: Do not draw the step's title or buttons inside the body; the wizard draws them from the attributes
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-wizard-step name="address" label="Адрес панели" type="form" description="По этому адресу вы будете открывать панель."><form><sf-input name="host" label="Адрес" required></sf-input></form></sf-wizard-step>

accessibility.focus: The step takes no focus; its controls are the page's.
